overall_notes: This paper focuses on text watermarking rather than traditional NLG generation. While it involves text manipulation, the primary goal is embedding/extracting information rather than generating new content. The evaluation metrics are specific to watermarking performance (BPW, BER) rather than standard NLG metrics like BLEU/ROUGE.
